resolvedIdentity: Tomb's historic manor and park landscape, now part of an active agricultural upper-secondary school and farm in Råde.

coordinateDecision.reason: The old manor house no longer survives. Rosehagen provides named geometry in the preserved historic park and yard core without claiming an unverified demolished-house footprint.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap way 309724146 – Rosehagen
findings: Rosehagen is a named park geometry at 59.31893, 10.81377.
It lies in the historic Tomb park and yard environment near the ponds and former manor core.

sources.name: Tomb videregående skole – Tombs historie
findings: The old main house stood near today's internat and characteristic ponds but no longer survives.
The manor park is a persistent landscape layer.
Tomb became an agricultural boarding school in 1939.

sources.name: Store norske leksikon – Tomb
findings: Tomb is a former manor and a large agricultural estate in Råde.
The old main building probably had roots in the sixteenth century and was demolished late in the nineteenth century.
The romantic park from around 1800 includes ponds, canals, vaulted bridges and memorial features.
The estate is now associated with Tomb upper-secondary school.

sources.name: Lokalhistoriewiki – Tomb herregård
findings: Tomb was a former setegård and manor at Tomballéen 7.
The property was acquired for school use in 1938 and school operations began in 1939.

sources.name: Tomb videregående skole – Besøk Tomb
findings: Selected attractions and activities are publicly presented.
The wider property remains an active school and agricultural operation rather than an unrestricted museum site.
